notes.title: Don’t Wake the Best is here! Check out my new project 🐲
notes.content:
[h1]Gamers! [/h1]

I'm so happy to be writing to you after such a long time! Since Flooded set sail, it’s been an unforgettable journey. And today, I’m thrilled to announce my new game, Don’t Wake the Beast!

This time, I’m diving into a roguelite stealth adventure where treasure hunting meets high-stakes danger. You’ll sneak through randomly generated dungeons, dodge traps and enemies, and - most importantly - steal treasures without waking the Beast. 

Every step counts… And every treasure brings you closer to being caught.

[previewyoutube=oAE7xReD7oo;full][/previewyoutube]

Yep, it’s a different genre, but if you enjoyed Flooded, I’d love for you to check out the trailer for Don’t Wake the Beast and add it to your wishlist. 

Just [b]click the banner below[/b]:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3258580/Dont_Wake_the_Beast/

Your support means the world, and I can’t wait to hear what you think of this new adventure. Stay tuned, and thanks for being part of this journey!

Follow me on:
📍 [url=https://www.facebook.com/artificialdisasters]Facebook[/url]
📍 [url=https://twitter.com/adisastersgames]X[/url]

See ya,
Tymek

notes.title: Post-Release Update #4 - New decorations and some bug fixes…
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149552/f13ad03fe3ea54b6a0cd558db892a201227a5d6d.png[/img]

[h1]Hello! [/h1]

Recently I took some time off to [b]recharge my batteries[/b], and now I'm back with even more energy to bring you a brand new update for Flooded.

Speaking of which… [b]It is now available[/b] and packed with some great features! They include three new decorations on different levels (Calm Ocean, Stormy Ocean, and North Ocean) and an entirely new technology - Demolition II.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149552/99dae4f4d72719d2dc2446f36f5ce10539536063.png[/img]

I've also [b]taken care of a bunch of bugs and glitches[/b] that were reported some time ago. Now the game will be even more enjoyable.

You'll find the complete changelog below, so [b]make sure to check it out[/b]:

[i]New features:
- 1 new technology (Demolition II)
- 1 new decoration on Calm Ocean
- 1 new decoration on Stormy Ocean
- 1 new decoration on North Ocean
- Added a glowing 'New' icon in Mode Menu when a new Commander or Relic was unlocked

Bugs fixed:
- Objective about discovering underground Mystery Spots gets automatically completed now, if there are no underground Mystery Spots left
- Fixed the bug that allowed to upgrade buildings for an infinite number of times
- Now Order Relic can't be used on a tower that is being upgraded or relocated
- Now towers don't shoot while being under construction, upgraded or relocated
- Now Order Relic 'shooting mode' is closed, if another window is opened
- Now Order Relic can't be used during pause or when the time is stopped
- Embankment and Defensive Dam disappear when the ground below them is destroyed by the boss in the 4th level
- Fixed a minor visual glitch appearing on Embankments
- Now a tooltip for destroying buildings doesn't appear while hovering over Miners Base (which, of course, can't be destroyed)
- Fixed depth value of the Strait that caused some objects in front of it to look like they are behind it
 
Other:
- Added a new visual effects for a few technologies
- Increased collision box of Defensive Dam
- Now chunks of resources drop next to the Shipyard if there is no enough space for resources gained by canceling ship construction
- Now chunks of resources drop from a building if there is no enough space for resources gained by demolishing that building[/i]

While these may not be [b]game-changing tweaks[/b], they'll surely add some pleasant variety to what's already been available for a while.

And rest assured, [b]this isn't the end of the road for Flooded[/b]. I’ll keep working on it, and there's more to come. Wishing you all a fantastic time and good luck in your battle against the flood!

Enjoy and have fun!
Tymek

notes.title: Post-Release Update #3 - New difficulty level, technologies and some fixes…
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149552/5f8c3f568df94c585d521f794c6085be40cadb07.png[/img]

[h1]Hello, folks![/h1]

I want to start this post by thanking you all for your feedback [b]since the release of Flooded[/b]. Your reports and comments about bugs or missing features have been incredibly helpful in improving the game, so thank you!

I’ve spent the past week working on addressing some of the issues you've mentioned, and I'm happy to announce that there are a ton of improvements in the newest update! Guys, [b]version 1.0.6 is here[/b]! 

[h2]Just chillin’[/h2]

One of the biggest new features is the addition of a new difficulty level called "Relaxed". It is now the easiest way to play Flooded - [b]the flood meter fills up slower[/b], which significantly reduces the stress associated with dealing with the flood. I think cozy game fans will love it (and not only them), because it will allow them to focus on building, rather than on surviving. 

[h2]What’s more…[/h2]

In addition to the new difficulty level, I've also added two new technologies - [b]Terraforming and Terraforming II[/b]! Both will help in case of water and electricity shortages, but I'll let you discover that yourself! Good luck!

Oh, and [b]are there any component fans here[/b]? There is a new one called “Wet Performance Screw” - you should defo try it out! Or maybe you want to test your luck? If so, then check the Mystery Box in the trade menu!

Furthermore, there are plenty of balancing changes, bug fixes, and other small improvements that should make the game even more enjoyable to play. [b]Check out the full changelog[/b] below for more details:

[i]New features:

2 new technologies (Terraforming + Terraforming II)
1 new component (Wet Performance Screw)
New difficulty level (Relaxed)
1 new decoration on Rocky Ocean
1 new decoration on Tropical Ocean
You can now cancel ship construction in the queue by clicking it
Added Mystery Box that can be purchased in the trade menu to obtain a random component

Balance changes:

Acid rain doesn't appear in the first era anymore
Now there are more free ground tiles among trees on Tropical Ocean
The island on the 7th level is now bigger
The island on the 9th level is now bigger

Bugs fixed:

Port description changed
Now particles emitted by fire, volcano and explosions don't move while the game is paused or the time is stopped
Now Embankments don't sink during Flood regardless of certain technologies (Melioration II, Artificial Islands II) being developed.
Newly collected components should now arrange on the grid in the right way
Natural Reservoir can't be built multiple times in the same spot anymore
Theo's (Discoverer) passive ability related to finding positive objects in Mystery Spots should now work without issues
Colors of particles emitted when a building is destroyed should now match the building's color
Ice Cream Shop can now be built only once per level (as the building's description claims)
The bug with rivers and fissures not spawning in the 10th level is now less frequent

Other changes:

Buildings that can't be upgraded don't have the level information box in their menu anymore.
Dark Performance Screw icon changed
Now play time statistic at the end of each level does not include time manipulation
Turret's range now increases with its level and is affected by Turret's performance statistic[/i]

Thanks again for your support, and don’t forget to [b]leave a review on Steam[/b] - it will be very helpful. 

Stay tuned for more!
Tymek

notes.title: Post-Release Update #2 - New technologies and more…
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149552/d39bcef31b3aaa11ba6c3cc50b406c824f415cac.png[/img]

[h1]Hi there! [/h1]

It's Friday and, just like I promised, [b]I have a new update for you[/b]! 

But first things first! I want to thank you all for your continuous support and for keeping an eye on the development of Flooded. The game wouldn't look as good as it does now without your dedication. You’re the best! 

[h2]Now, on to the exciting stuff! [/h2]

I've added two new technologies - [b]Cryptology and Z Virus[/b] - as well as a new component called the Dark Performance Screw. What do they do? You need to check it out yourself, but I’m sure they’ll be an exciting addition to Flooded, especially in the later stages of the game!

I’ve also [b]fixed some of the bugs[/b] that were reported over the past few days. Flooded should now provide more fun and fewer frustrating moments that could make the game less enjoyable.

[b]The full changelog is listed below[/b]:

[i]New features:

- 2 new technologies (Cryptology + Z Virus)
- 1 new component (Dark Performance Screw)
- 2 new decorations on Toxic Ocean
- You can now purchase iron in exchange for copper or lead using trade menu
- Now you can have a maximum of 20 technologies at the same time instead of just 10

Bugs fixed:

- Issue with oil spills spawning in strange patterns
- Bug related to building range not covering the whole island is now less frequent
- Game progress is now saved less often, which should reduce the likelihood of corrupting save files
- Now land tiles should always have the right appearance based on their adjacency to the ocean
- Artificial grounds built around the shore shouldn't now reduce the island's building range
- Diamond Pickaxe relic can no longer be used to mine resources while the time is stopped using active pause[/i]

Lastly, thanks everyone for [b]leaving a review on Steam[/b]. I'll be back with more updates soon, and I hope that today's one is to your liking!

See ya,
Tymek

notes.title: Flooded has been out for a week!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149552/6f5d4b898273ba6ed2f1275fc8e5abbd510f01c9.png[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone! 👋[/h1]

Can you believe it's been a whole week since I released Flooded? Time flies! I wanted to use this opportunity to reflect on the past days and share my own impressions on the launch.

Firstly, I'm thrilled with how everything went and I'm over the moon that so many of you played my game. At its peak, 74 people were playing simultaneously, which is an amazing result! What's even better is that, even though it's been several days now, there are still at least a dozen people playing the game almost constantly!

[h2]Reviews 🎮[/h2]

You know what’s exciting? Flooded has been making waves in the gaming world! It's been featured on some of the [b]biggest gaming sites out there[/b], including:

[h3]📰 PC Gamer[/h3]

[i]“I faced some tricky choices as I played: if there's a copper node close to shore, should I set up a mine on it to quickly extract as much as I can? Or should I leave it and build my factory further inland where I know the building won't be swallowed by the ocean within the next few minutes?”[/i]

[h3]📰 Destructoid[/h3]

[i]“For being a rather unique premise, Flooded offers a very tight and polished experience. It’s the sort of thing where I’m afraid that if you either add something or take it away, it will stop working. Just a terrific execution of its thesis. I’m not certain it will necessarily soak your socks like some more expansive builders might, but your time spent stranded will be worthwhile.”[/i]

[h3]📰 Even the Financial Times![/h3]

[i]“It’s a compelling combination of base-building, tower defence and real-time strategy whose procedurally generated maps, different modes and £10 price tag more than make up for its relatively short campaign length. And its combination of human and environmental threats is an effective reminder that when it comes to the climate, we are often our own worst enemies.”[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149552/64a3a03280325090ab937f0e4633368236ae57f8.png[/img]

In addition, many well-known creators (like Raptor, Orbital Potato or Lutel) have streamed the game! 

Can you believe it? I still can't!

[h2]Thank you! 🙏🏽[/h2]

Once more, [b]I wanted to send a big thank you[/b] to everyone who's been playing Flooded and sharing their thoughts on Steam. Your support means everything to me. I also want to encourage you to leave reviews, as they really help the game reach new people.

Finally, I'm excited to announce that [b]a new update will be released this Friday[/b]! It will add some content and fix a couple of the bugs you've been telling me about.

Thanks again for your support, and I can't wait to see you all in the game!
Tymek

notes.title: Balance changes and first fixes - post-release update is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149552/6452b28f4bf696a1bcba9d4f391102ba5e9724f2.png[/img]

[h1]Gamers! [/h1]

These past few days have been absolutely crazy! But now the dust has settled and I have the first update for you.

Before I tell you more about the changes, I want to thank all of you for your support, feedback, reviews ([b][u]especially those on Steam - they mean the world to me[/u][/b]) and just for playing Flooded. I am so happy to see that the reception has been positive. It is incredibly helpful in shaping the future of the game.

[h2]Update[/h2]

Now moving on to the update. [b]The most important change involves balancing[/b]. Our goal was to make the game challenging. The rising water is supposed to create pressure, so that players need to act fast. However, we can now see that not everyone is enjoying this as much as we do. Because of that I have extended the time for the flood meter to fill and I have reduced the impact of rain on the flood meter (on all difficulty levels). I’m hoping this will make the experience more enjoyable.

I have also added some quality-of-life features: the ability to skip splash screens when launching the game, the possibility to demolish Embankment and Defensive Dam, North Ocean now has 1 new landmark type decoration.

Keep an eye out for further updates and in the meantime, [b]here’s a full changelog[/b]:

[i]New features:
- Now you can skip splash screens with logos by pressing Space, Enter, Escape or LMB
- Embankment and Defensive Dam can be now demolished in destroying mode
- 1 new landmark-type decoration on North Ocean

Balance changes:
- Time till each flood is now a bit longer in all difficulty modes
- Rain global effect has now less significant effect on flood meter speed

Bugs fixed:
- Fixed small white dot appearing close to Lead Open-Pit Mines
- Now 'Reinforcement' technology affects also already built buildings
- Fixed Water Pump visual glitch in upgrading mode while using flattened view
- Water Filters are now being flattened in flattened view, as all other objects
- Now idle miners number can't be negative (but there may be still some other issues releated to miners)
- Now Ore deposit underground can't be put in 'hidden' state by obstacles on the surface

Other changes:
- Updated credits

[b]HOTFIX 1.0.4.1[/b]

New features:
- Added a notification when there are not enough Miners
- Added a notification when not enough Water is produced
- Added Tutorial in the 2nd level reminding about mining system rules[/i]

If you encounter any bug, don't forget to let us know about it. Have fun!

See ya,
Tymek

notes.title: Flooded is OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149552/9f903ed484a0a9b98f666440c89171a387f5a821.png[/img]

[h1]Gamers![/h1]

[b]I am thrilled to announce that Flooded is finally available! [/b]

It's been a long and exciting journey to get to this point. They say that dreams don't come true - [b]you have to make them happen[/b]. And that's exactly what I did. I've always had a passion for game development and have been working hard to make this dream a reality. 

[previewyoutube=pWAIm8y7lUw;full][/previewyoutube]

Seeing my game finally released on Steam is a truly special moment, and [b]I'm so grateful to everyone[/b] who helped make it happen.

Flooded is a project that [b]I poured my heart and soul into[/b], and I'm excited to share it with all of you. For a limited time, it will be on sale, so if you're looking for a new and exciting game to play, this is the perfect opportunity to pick it up at a great price - you can get it at 10% off for a week!

[h2]Bundles[/h2]

You can elevate your gaming collection with a bundle of Flooded and other incredible games, all at an unbeatable prices. Opting for the bundle is certainly the smartest choice, trust me. Without further ado, [b]here are the available options[/b]:

▪️ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31641/New_citybuilders_bundle/]Cardboard Town Bundle[/url]
▪️ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31686/Urbek_City_Builder_x_Flooded_bundle/]Urbek City Builder Bundle[/url]
▪️ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31627/Rogue_AI_Simulator_x_Flooded_Bundle/]Rogue AI Simulator Bundle[/url]
▪️ Shardpunk: Verminfall Bundle (Coming Soon)

[h2]Feedback[/h2]

I encourage you to share your experiences with Flooded. If you have any feedback, suggestions, or questions about the game, feel free to send me a message, [b]write in the Community HUB section on Steam[/b] or via social media (all links below). I'm always eager to hear from players and learn how I can make the game even better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149552/c4df704f87656fa007924c6359e047630d9b02af.gif[/img]

Reviews are also incredibly important for a successful release and I will be deeply grateful if you leave a review of Flooded on Steam. It helps other players discover the game and decide if it's right for them. Every review makes a difference, so please take a few minutes to share your thoughts on Flooded. 

[h2]Thank you![/h2]

In the end, I want to take a moment to thank everyone who has supported me throughout the development of Flooded. [b]Your encouragement, input, and kind words mean the world to me[/b], and I couldn't have done it without you. Now the journey continues, and I will spend the coming days and weeks making small improvements and implementing your feedback!

I'm so proud and grateful for the opportunity to share Flooded with you. Thank you for being a part of it!

Tymek

notes.title: Flooded is postponed!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149552/24f8ced965df12d8aca7a7be156aca0d2ae19496.png[/img]

[h1]Gamers![/h1]

It’s one of those days when I have to tell you something sad. I’ve decided to change the release date for Flooded - [b]we are now moving to April 12th[/b]. 

I understand that this news may be disappointing to many of you, but [b]over the last 2 weeks I ran additional rounds of tests[/b] and I would like to use this time to implement the feedback. I realized that I’m not utilizing the full potential of Commanders and Relics, therefore I will be adding more of them, which will require additional balancing. 

I want to ensure that the game is of the highest quality and meets your expectations!

I would also like to stress that besides the above features Flooded is ready for launch, so [b]April 12th will be the final date[/b]. I can’t wait to see how you’ll cope with the flood! Thank you for your patience and continued support.

See ya,
Tymek

notes.title: What’s New? #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149552/967ff34c2428f801b13d330c6781935ece0350c4.png[/img]

Some time has passed since the last "What's New?"… But that's how it is when [b]so many important things happen[/b]! Nevertheless, it is a good time to shed some light on what I have been working on over the past months. Flooded is growing all the time!

Firstly, there will be a [b]stats menu in the game[/b]. It will allow you to check some more and less important numbers from your playthroughs - including the number of constructed buildings, destroyed pirate ships, defeated bosses, chests opened, etc.

There will also be an option to change the binding of the keys, which you have asked about a lot. Considering the nature of the game, this may be useful, so [b]thank you for your feedback[/b] and I will look into your other suggestions as well!

[h2]That’s not all[/h2]

I also have to mention [b]the terrain flattening feature[/b] which makes the view of the island much clearer - I wrote more about it on social media, so I strongly encourage you to [url=https://twitter.com/floodedgame/status/1592472923767349249]check out this post[/url]! However, I didn't say that I added epilogue dialogue, so… You are the first to hear about it! 

Last but not least, I was working on indestructible boulders. Obstacles have always had some positive effects (for example, destroying them could drop cool items), so [b]they had to be made a bit less pleasant[/b]. The boulder will take up space, and you will not be able to remove it (evil laugh). 

As you can see, a lot is happening! And [b]thanks a lot[/b], because you keep tossing me phenomenal ideas I want to add to the game. You’re the best! 

Until next time, stay tuned,
Tymek

notes.content:

[h2]Gamers![/h2]

Although recently I've been focused mainly on PAX West and my trip to Seattle ([b]can’t wait to meet you there[/b]), that's not the only good news I can share with you this week. The plane can wait because...

I can proudly announce that [b]I have signed a deal with Surefire.Games[/b] - a company that will publish and promote Flooded in China! This means many new players will come to face a dangerous flood and other adversities. As if that was not enough, support for the Chinese language will be added to the game soon! [b]最后[/b]!

Surefire.Games is a team that worked on titles such as Cursed Treasure 2, Oaken, War Mongrels, and [b]even on Lumencraft published by befriended Star Drifters[/b]. I am looking forward to the fruits of my cooperation with Surefire - I’m convinced that they will be fresh, juicy and very tasty.

Stay tuned for more info while I'm backpacking! I will have some surprises for you in the USA!

As you probably know (or not), on Monday at 10 am PDT / 1 pm EDT /  6 pm BST, the [b]next edition of Steam Next Fest starts[/b]…

Now let me take a deep breath and tell you something very important. Ready?

[i]>Inhale<[/i]

[b]Flooded will be a part of that event! I have prepared some treats, so I am sure you won’t be bored[/b]!

That's right, throughout the Steam Next Fest, [b]you will be able to check out the demo version of Flooded[/b], in which you can try your hand at 2 levels of the game. I guarantee this can be challenging - operating under time pressure is not that simple!

If you don't have time on June 14 at 10 am PDT, then… No problem![b] I will loop a pre-recorded gameplay video[/b] with commentary on the Steam page for the duration of the Festival :)

Have fun!

notes.title: Meet the Team…
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149552/8b68bbd6529f1a2bf4a76f30315d5cdb7157b5a3.png[/img]

[b]Before you set off, you should assemble a team[/b]… And its most important component will always be the commander, who is in charge of coordinating the team’s actions, uniting the group and deciding on the most important things.

In Flooded, before each game, [b]you will be able to choose a commander[/b] to manage your attempts to survive a historical flood. However, they will not be the same - each of them offers specific perks and special ways to reach your goals. Today I will introduce you to some of them!

[h2]Myles (Specialization: Strategy)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149552/92b31bdf64c26b784b52694c6bdfce3dbeb15e48.png[/img]

Bonus: [u]Adjacent buildings of the same type work more efficiently.[/u]

The first character is a slim man with dark hair combed in an old-fashioned way. [b]He is great at building various strategies[/b] and his main strength is paperwork. He makes up for his physical shortcomings with his cleverness and analytical approach to each problem.

[h2]Ellen (Specialization: Construction)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149552/07554fdf71703a2adab7e9f83729a214e2ae5ae9.png[/img]

Bonus: [u]Buildings can be relocated.[/u]

A hardworking woman with a ponytail always hidden under a helmet. You must know she is the only one who has never worked in a mine. However, [b]Ellen is not afraid to get her hands dirty[/b], and her experience in other industries is a big advantage in a natural crisis.

[h2]Henry (Specialization: Defense)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149552/6fa0ef25f9684a3b3d53510bcf46807940f8c72f.png[/img]

Bonus: [u]The default durability of buildings is increased.[/u]

This guy is the opposite of Myles - a [b]characterful and well-built blonde[/b] who believes in muscle strength. Although, it must be noted, he never uses it to hurt another person. Henry is mild-mannered by nature, but very charismatic. He can easily lead a group of miners and motivate them to work harder! 

[h2]Thomas (Specialization: Technologies)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42149552/6ada42a0e01cebecbc1d35c3e63dce73a5b1d17d.png[/img]

Bonus: [u]Buildings have an additional level of development.[/u]

The youngest of the group of potential commanders and probably the most distracted. However, it is a [b]textbook image of a real genius[/b]. His short-lived enthusiasm does not allow him to finish the tasks he has already started, but his impressive knowledge can help you escape the island… The choice is yours!

[b]See ya![/b]
